notes: The wiring diagram image (diagram-v1.png) was not provided, so connections follow the text: OLED and DHT11 are powered from 3V3, OLED uses I2C, DHT11 data is on D4.
The parts list said the Nano Matter was not in the catalogue, but arduino-nano-matter exists, so I used it.
The catalogue entry for arduino-nano-matter has no SDA/SCL ports. I mapped I2C to A4 (SDA) and A5 (SCL), as on the Nano form factor. This is an assumption.

The exact breadboard holes are not given. The board is assumed to straddle the centre channel with its used pins at 3t.e, 4t.e, 5t.e, 10b.f and 11b.f. The OLED is at 20t–23t and the DHT11 at 27t–29t. These holes are illustrative. The strip connectivity (which pin joins which) follows the text.
The DHT11 module is treated as 3 used pins (VCC, SIG, GND). Its NC pin is unused.
The USB-C cable connects to the board's USB port. The cable has no catalogue ports, so none are named.
The Google Nest Hub Max (Thread Border Router) and the software are not part of the build graph.
